items.name: Finset.mulConst_le_divConst_sq
items.type: ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G] [inst_1 : DecidableEq G] {A : Finset G}, A.mulConst A ≤ A.divConst A ^ 2

items.name: Finset.divConst_le_mulConst_sq
items.type: ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : DecidableEq G] {A : Finset G}, A.divConst A ≤ A.mulConst A ^ 2

items.name: lt_of_mul_self_lt_mul_self₀
items.type:
∀ {M₀ : Type u_2} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] [inst_1 : LinearOrder M₀] [PosMulStrictMono M₀] {a b : M₀} [MulPosMono M₀],
  0 ≤ b → a * a < b * b → a < b

items.name: tendsto_apply_add_mul_sq_div_sub
items.type:
∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x a c d : ℝ} {l : Filter ℝ},
  l ≤ nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun y => (f y - d) / (y - x)) l (nhds a) →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun y => y + c * (y - x) ^ 2) l l →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun y => (f (y + c * (y - x) ^ 2) - d) / (y - x)) l (nhds a)

items.name: mabs_div_lt_of_one_le_of_lt
items.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G] [inst_1 : LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedMonoid G] {a b n : G},
  1 ≤ a → a < n → 1 ≤ b → b < n → |a / b|ₘ < n
